content.text: Digital creators often face significant hurdles when trying to sell ebooks, especially in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are not available. This limitation forces creators to explore alternative solutions for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-honest-side-side-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-2|The Top]]-ethiopian-digital-creators-only-real-3|payment]] processing. In this guide, you’ll learn how to set up a sovereign commerce stack that allows you to accept Bitcoin for your ebook sales, eliminating reliance on traditional payment platforms and their high fees.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-13. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Traditional platforms like Gumroad impose high fees, taking up to 10% of each sale. In contrast, the infrastructure provided by COREMERCH, utilizing NOWPayments, charges only 0.5%. This significant cost reduction means that for a $97 ebook, the fee difference is substantial. With 100 sales per month, you retain an additional $921, which can be reinvested into your business. By owning your infrastructure, you eliminate the risk of payment rejections and account freezes that often plague creators relying on conventional platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can launch your ebook store, gather the essential components. You'll need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account to process Bitcoin transactions, and access to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for product delivery. Additionally, ensure you have your digital products ready for upload—this includes your ebooks and any associated files like templates or fonts. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for automating backend processes. This groundwork is crucial for a smooth deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your chosen stack, starting with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Integrate NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing, ensuring it’s configured to handle automatic payment confirmations. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of your ebooks once a payment has been verified. This automation ensures your customers receive their products instantly, enhancing their purchasing experience. Ensure that your pipeline is tested thoroughly to handle transactions seamlessly before going live.
Own your infrastructure, eliminate platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up and tested, it’s time to go live. Share your store link, ensuring it directs customers to your GitHub or Cloudflare hosted site. Monitor your first transaction closely, checking that the payment processes correctly through NOWPayments and that the ebook delivery is automated without issues. Engage with your customers to gather feedback on their purchasing experience. This initial phase is critical for ensuring that your setup works flawlessly and meets customer expectations.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store operational, focus on scaling your business. Use the insights gained from initial sales to refine your offerings and marketing strategies. Leverage the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that can enhance your store. Consider expanding your product range to include more digital items, such as templates and plugins. Automate as much of your workflow as possible to handle increased sales volume efficiently. This proactive approach positions you for sustained growth.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign digital commerce stack. By deploying your own store infrastructure with NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing, you retain ownership and control of your sales process. This setup eliminates high fees and payment barriers often encountered with traditional platforms.
Retain control of your sales with instant payment processing.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking to build a robust digital download store that operates exclusively on crypto without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It provides all the necessary blueprints to create, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I accept Bitcoin for my ebook sales?

Set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it into your chosen hosting platform. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare for hosting your ebooks and automate delivery through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which can charge up to 10%. This means more profit retained for you.
Can I sell other digital products besides ebooks?
Yes, you can sell a variety of digital products such as templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The infrastructure allows for multiple product types.
What happens if my payment fails?
With the infrastructure you set up, you will own the entire process. If a payment fails, you can troubleshoot directly without relying on a third-party platform to resolve issues.
How can I scale my store after launch?
Once your store is operational, focus on expanding your product offerings and automating processes. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit for additional resources to enhance your infrastructure.
